catenaShort: Quoted verbatim from the Catena Aurea on the Gospel of St Matthew, compiled by St Thomas Aquinas from the Fathers (Oxford: J.G.F. & J. Rivington, 1842; public domain).
catenaLong: The patristic commentary is quoted verbatim from the Catena Aurea on St Matthew — the “golden chain” of the Fathers compiled by St Thomas Aquinas (Oxford: J.G.F. & J. Rivington, 1842; public domain) — restricted here to Fathers venerated as saints in the Orthodox Church.
